question.prompt: Name a movie set mostly or partly in outer space.
question.criteria: Any released feature film with scenes set in outer space, including aboard spacecraft or space stations, counts. Animated films count too.

aliases: Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope
answers.evidence: The original Star Wars follows a galactic adventure involving spacecraft and the Death Star.
Interstellar follows astronauts who travel through a wormhole in search of a habitable world.
Gravity follows astronauts struggling to survive after a disaster in Earth orbit.
Alien takes place largely aboard the commercial spacecraft Nostromo.
The Martian combines an astronaut's survival on Mars with scenes aboard an interplanetary spacecraft.
Guardians of the Galaxy follows a team of outlaws traveling through space.
WALL-E follows a robot from Earth to a passenger spacecraft.
2001: A Space Odyssey includes journeys aboard spacecraft and a mission toward Jupiter.
Aliens follows a mission to an extraterrestrial colony aboard the spacecraft Sulaco.
Apollo 13 dramatizes the real lunar mission and its astronauts' struggle to return to Earth.
Spaceballs is a science-fiction parody featuring spacecraft and interplanetary travel.
Galaxy Quest sends actors from a fictional television series aboard a real alien spacecraft.
Event Horizon follows a rescue crew investigating a spacecraft that has mysteriously returned.
Sunshine follows a spacecraft crew on a mission to reignite the Sun.
Moon is set primarily at a lunar base and includes spacecraft travel.
Silent Running centers on a spacecraft carrying preserved forests from Earth.
Dark Star follows the crew of a spacecraft assigned to destroy unstable planets.
Europa Report depicts a crewed spacecraft mission to Jupiter's moon Europa.

aliases: Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back
answers.evidence: The Empire Strikes Back includes spacecraft journeys and a pursuit through an asteroid field.

aliases: Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi
answers.evidence: Return of the Jedi includes a space battle around the second Death Star.
Armageddon sends a drilling team into space to stop an asteroid from hitting Earth.
The Fifth Element includes interplanetary travel and scenes aboard a space cruise liner.
Passengers takes place aboard a spacecraft carrying people to a distant colony.
Ad Astra follows an astronaut on a journey through the solar system.
Treasure Planet reimagines Treasure Island as an animated adventure aboard spacefaring ships.

answers.canonical: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
answers.evidence: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan features a confrontation between spacecraft commanded by Kirk and Khan.
Solaris is the title of films centered on a space station orbiting a mysterious planet.
The Black Hole follows space explorers who discover a spacecraft near a black hole.
Outland is a science-fiction thriller set at a mining colony on Jupiter's moon Io.

question.explanation: Space settings appear in science-fiction adventures, comedies, animated films and dramatizations of real missions. A movie does not need to take place entirely in space to qualify.
